A SOULSILVER Marketing Agency cookie- (s: The SOULSILVER Marketing Agency cookie policy: which cookies we use, for what purpose, and how you can manage your consent.
A süti egy kis adatfájl, amelyet a webol: A cookie is a small data file that a website places in your browser. It lets the site recognise a returning visitor, remember settings and produce traffic statistics. On their own, cookies cannot directly identify you personally.
Az oldal működéséhez és a süti-választás: Indispensable to the operation of the site and to remembering your cookie choice (for example, storing that decision in your browser).
Anonim módon mérik a látogatottságot és: Measure traffic and site usage anonymously (Google measurement services).
A hirdetések teljesítményének mérése és: Measuring advertising performance and serving relevant ads (Google Ads).
A weboldalon jelenleg a <strong>Google</: The site currently runs Google services (Google Ads / measurement, gtag). These cookies are activated when you click “Accept” in the cookie bar.
Az oldal első betöltésekor egy süti-sáv: On your first visit a cookie bar appears where you can choose “Accept” or “Decline”. Your browser stores that decision (in local storage), so we don't ask again on your next visit.
Ha módosítanád a korábbi döntésedet, tör: To change an earlier decision, clear the stored data for this site in your browser — the cookie bar will then appear again.
A legtöbb böngészőben be tudod állítani,: Most browsers let you refuse cookies altogether, or delete cookies already stored. The exact steps differ by browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) — look for “Settings → Privacy / Cookies”. Note: if you block essential cookies, some functions of the site will not work properly.
A személyes adatok kezeléséről bővebben: You can read more about how personal data is handled in our Privacy Policy. If you have any questions, write to info@soulsilvermarketing.com.
